Demand.description: Electricity demand, measured in near real time.

at.description: Instant of the latest measured value. Usually about 10 minutes behind the clock.

forecast_mw.description: What the operator had forecast for the same instant.

low_today.description: Lowest measured demand so far today.

peak_today.description: Highest measured demand so far today.

resolution_minutes.description: Spacing of the readings in minutes. Null when only one reading exists yet.

scheduled_mw.description: What the market had scheduled for the same instant.

at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp carrying the Europe/Madrid UTC offset

Generation.description:
Generation mix for one day. Red Eléctrica publishes this per day, not live, and
revises recent days for a while, so treat the latest figures as provisional.

co2_g_per_kwh.description: Average emissions per unit generated, in grams of CO2 equivalent per kWh.

co2_tonnes.description: Total emissions from generation over the day, in tonnes of CO2 equivalent.

day.description: The day these figures cover, `YYYY-MM-DD`: the most recent completed day published.

renewable_percent.description:
Share of generation from renewable sources, 0 to 100. Null when the answer
does not classify every technology (see `warnings`).

total_mwh.description: Total generation over the day, in megawatt-hours.

Source.description: Where a document's data came from. Every document lists its sources.

cached.description: True when served from the local cache instead of the network.

fetched_at.description: When this program retrieved it from upstream.

name.description: Publisher of the data. Cite it when you reuse a figure.

updated_at.description: When the publisher last updated this data. Cite it along with the name.

url.description: The upstream request that produced it.

Technology.description: One generation technology's output over a day.

id.description:
Identifier for the technology, for example `wind`, `solar_pv`, `nuclear`,
`combined_cycle`. Known technologies keep theirs; one this version does not know
gets an identifier derived from its Spanish name.

mwh.description: Energy generated over the day, in megawatt-hours.

name_es.description: Name as published by Red Eléctrica (Spanish).

percent.description: Share of the day's total generation, 0 to 100.

renewable.description: Null when Red Eléctrica's answer does not classify the technology.

description: The state of Spain's electricity system: live demand plus the latest daily mix.

area.description: Always `spain`: demand and generation are national totals (mainland and islands).

at.description: The instant this answer was produced.

demand.description: Null when the demand feed could not be read (see `warnings`).

generation.description: Null when the generation figures could not be read (see `warnings`).

warnings.description: Parts of the answer that are missing, and why. Empty when complete.
